commands:
mkdir -p /app/ssl
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout /app/ssl/server.key -out /app/ssl/server.crt -days 365 -subj '/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local'
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.key
cat /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt > /app/ssl/server.pem
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -dates -fingerprint -sha256 > /app/ssl/verification.txt
cat > /app/check_cert.py <<'CHECK'
import ssl
from pathlib import Path
certificate=ssl._ssl._test_decode_cert('/app/ssl/server.crt')
for parts in certificate['subject']:
    for name,value in parts:
        if name=='commonName': print(value)
from datetime import datetime
print(datetime.strptime(certificate['notAfter'],'%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z').strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
print('Certificate verification successful')
CHECK
python3 /app/check_cert.py
